suggestions.pitch: At 0-3 with no contention window, Jefferson and Love for young WRs Nabers and Arroyo is the likeliest accepted (0.74) and costs the fewest points of the rebuild offers.
Kyren Williams and Jefferson for Nabers and Burden converts veterans into two young high-market WRs at 0.72 likelihood.
Kelce, age 37, and Love for young WR Matthew Golden sells declining value for the future.
